theme: A quiet Sunday, Croatia on the clock
greeting: A wide-open Sunday with the girls home in St. Pete, and only the 15-minute review with Mike on the calendar. The real weight this week is Croatia: departure is nine days out and several P1 bookings are still open on the board.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat night still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 post-charter night in Cavtat, plus the noon transfer from Komolac, has to be booked from dry land before you fly on Sept 8 since connectivity aboard is nil. It is P1 and overdue since Aug 26 on the Mike + Dan board.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20-22 gap between your TPA landing and the Tuesday kid pickup still needs lodging, and the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb should be confirmed as converted from pending. P1, overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags; verify baggage on the Eurowings Discover record locator and pre-buy if needed, since airport-counter fees run far higher. P1, overdue since Aug 25.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: 15-minute board reset: clear the inbox, put an owner and date on everything.

flagged.title: Nautilus Sailing balance due
flagged.detail: QuickBooks says invoice 2170 for the Croatia course isn't finished, with $6,475 still outstanding.

flagged.title: Care.com replies waiting
flagged.detail: A caregiver message and several new applicants to your posted job are sitting unread.

inbox.noise: The rest is WSJ, NYT Cooking, and Care.com applicant alerts.

resolved.title: Croatia instructor confirmed
resolved.detail: Paul at Nautilus introduced himself for the Sept 12 course and the crew intro thread is rolling; nothing is owed from you.
